gaps.empirical_consequence: Different retained columns change ranks and geometry; different series sets can share the same value hash and provenance identity.
gaps.issue: The approved text does not say whether expanding and rolling histories select retained series independently, and the key hashes matrices without ordered series IDs.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze history-specific selection and bind ordered series IDs, masks, and matrices for both histories into every scenario identity.

gaps.empirical_consequence: All operations are individually defensible but do not commute, so alternative orders can change admissible scenarios and authorization.
gaps.issue: No executable ordering composes timing stress, family deletion, history slicing, coverage filtering, exact deduplication, standardization, near-duplicate resolution, channel reweighting, scenario deduplication, and provenance aggregation.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze a single ordered pipeline, scenario-ID grammar, representative rule, and many-to-one provenance map before fitting.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Unregistered ordinal encodings or skipped exact collapse can select a different series.
gaps.issue: The harness expects numeric timing strength, revision exposure, and first-usable origin, but the frozen manifest supplies categorical strings and YYYY-MM values; exact-duplicate collapse is declared but not implemented by the redundancy primitive.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze categorical rank maps and month encoding, execute exact value-and-missingness collapse first, and apply one deterministic representative rule to both duplicate stages.

gaps.empirical_consequence: B2 authorization and matched participation cannot be reproduced and benchmark loss can change under multiple plausible constructions.
gaps.issue: The amendment names an equal-weight scalar score and a three-dimensional geometry grid but does not define the B2 score projector, channel operator, or anchor statistic.
gaps.required_resolution: Define the expanding and rolling combined scalar, duplicate-neutral channel operator, anchor summary, and exact three gate statistics.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Zero-filling changes the convex problem, low-rank recovery, selected rank, and B3 loss.
gaps.issue: The current SVD update inserts zero at unobserved cells, while the registered objective penalizes residuals only on observed cells; missing-cell continuation and downstream geometry construction are not frozen.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze a projected observed-entry iteration, initialization, missing-cell continuation, post-recovery rank/channel geometry, and convergence identity.

gaps.empirical_consequence: The control gate either leaks evaluation results or remains impossible to evaluate at the calibration lock.
gaps.issue: The calibration-stage rule asks whether NC1/NC2 satisfy every primary success condition, but those conditions include sealed evaluation metrics.
gaps.required_resolution: Define calibration-only analogues for Stage A, freeze control settings there, and reserve the unchanged evaluation control assessment for Stage B.

gaps.empirical_consequence: An implementation can omit identity-changing inputs or inadvertently serialize sealed metrics while still producing valid-looking hashes.
gaps.issue: Stage A permits evaluation scenario identities but does not define hash payload, cardinality, coordinate order, or allowed preprocessing.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze a per-origin/per-scenario canonical identity over coordinates, retained series, masks, matrix hashes, provenance mapping, and a no-metric serialization boundary.

gaps.empirical_consequence: A partial lock can pass its body hash while omitting a threshold, comparator, control, origin count, failure reason, or exact code identity.
gaps.issue: The lock writer accepts unrestricted settings, metrics, and invariance mappings and an unvalidated implementation string.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze required keys and types, full commit/source hashes, origin counts, comparator and control settings, and schema validation before atomic creation.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Aggregate metrics cannot reveal silent origin loss, failed-fit handling, or label/decision misalignment.
gaps.issue: No immutable row schema records scenario failures, representatives, authorization, matured reference labels, candidate losses, and exclusions at each calibration origin.
gaps.location: calibration origin ledger and label materialization
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze a complete 60-origin ledger, require matured labels through the embargo, and hash the ledger into the Stage-A lock.
